description: 1D latitude and longitude arrays for the WRF_d02_bigua.nc domain (south_north and east_west dimensions), recovered after the original merged NetCDF lost its georeference during CDO processing.
source: Google Drive (provided by Danilo Couto de Souza)
notes: Used by scripts/analysis_01_preprocessing/prepare_wrf_for_lec.py to georeference data/WRF_d02_bigua_LEC.nc, replacing the index-based south_north/east_west dims with real lat/lon coordinates.
